exact_statement: For every fixed finite nonconstant gate table and ordered support covers satisfying the forests.tex interface, positive feasible lambda, nonempty covered set A and eligible assignment tau, let V be the used gates and c its number of source SCCs in the directed ownership-incidence graph, e=|V|-c, and b_tau=2^(-B_nonroot). Put w_uv(x)=sum_{j in A_u intersect R_v}x_(u,j) for u!=v and use incoming Laplacian L_vv=sum_u w_uv, L_vu=-w_uv. Let T_tau(x)=sum_{R selecting one root in each source SCC} product_{r in R}pi_r det L_(V\R,V\R)(x). For the monomial map M(product x^h)=product h!, the exact sum over distinct actual once-per-gate partition-forest queue runs with this assignment is sum_r 2^(-B(A;r))=b_tau M(T_tau). Different assignments are disjoint. With T_can=T_tau(1), D_(u,j)=number of eligible child gates at attachment group (u,j), a_D=(D+1)/2 for D>=1 and a_0=1, T_can<=M(T_tau)<=min(e!T_can,T_tau(a_D)). These determinant bounds are rational for rational pi, and can be summed with the separately algebraic b_tau to bound the full optimized residual cost -log2 sum_tau b_tau M(T_tau). T_tau factors into grounded non-source SCC determinants and rarity-weighted source-SCC cofactor sums, but its factorial-moment expectation need not factor across SCCs. The e! bound is sharp on positive-mass sunflower prime-table assignments. This computes the surrogate B mass, not exact queue probabilities, and asserts no universal O(I) or FEI bound.

exact_statement: For every finite simple graph positive edge DNF with one fixed full endpoint order per edge and positive globally fixed packing weights, the complete surrogate posterior partition-forest mass on every covered nonempty independent selected set A is exactly W_A=product_{j in A}[(1/4) sum_{e incident j} lambda_e r_e(j)^(-6/5)]. For the positive all-prime table of K_p,q for every integer p,q>=2, fixing lambda_e=1/max(p,q) and placing the smaller-side endpoint first gives the complete foresttarget residual R <= (91/20+4/(3 ln2)) I < (13/2) I. Hence the variational infimum over all positive weights/full orders and either output side cannot grow on this family. The identity is about surrogate B mass, not exact conditioned queue probabilities; no universal PI-J bound, sharp optimum, or new FEI class theorem is asserted.
